lead.headline: AB81 kept the first claim. Now it’s a 0.07-point game.
lead.dek: The wire ran at 12:10 AM and produced three moves, none of them AB81’s. Overnight, Derrick Henry and Kyren Williams came off the injury report and Sam Darnold went from Out to Questionable. Big Stric Energy 152.1, AB81 152.17, 49.9% to 50.1%.
lead.pull: Passing on the first claim is a bet on the injury report. So far the injury report is paying out.
body: Yesterday this column said AB81 needed a quarterback and held the No. 1 claim to get one. The waiver run went through at 12:10 AM. It produced three moves: two by Bad things man bad things, one by Maye I touch your TDs?. AB81 made none. The front office walked up to the front of the line, looked at the menu, and kept its spot.

Here’s why that might be fine. The injury report moved overnight, and almost all of it moved AB81’s way. Derrick Henry (13.76 projected) and Kyren Williams (15.14) no longer carry injury designations. Sam Darnold, listed Out yesterday, is now Questionable with a quadriceps and projects for 15.5, more than either starting quarterback. Justin Herbert (14.62) is still Questionable with a concussion. Matthew Stafford (13.46) is still the only sure thing.

So the question at quarterback has changed. It isn’t “who do we claim?” anymore. It’s “Herbert or Darnold?” Both are Questionable and the call is due Sun 1:25 PM. The risk is the version where both sit, because Jalen Hurts is still on IR and there is no fourth healthy quarterback on the roster. The wire still has one: Deshaun Watson projects for 16.69, more than Herbert, Darnold or Stafford, and he’s unclaimed in R.A.T.S. Free agency doesn’t need a claim order. It needs a roster spot.

The rest of AB81’s homework is easier and it’s all in-house. Germie Bernard (7.41) starts at receiver with DeVonta Smith (13.86) and Mike Evans (13.49) on the bench; that call locks Thu 1:30 PM. Rico Dowdle (7.86) holds a flex spot with Evans and George Kittle (12.1) available; that one is due Sun 1:25 PM. Mark Andrews (7.97) starts at tight end and has been dropped 390,528 times across Sleeper this week. As set, AB81 projects for 133.92. At its best, 152.17.

Big Stric Energy has its own sorting to do. Saquon Barkley has shed his injury tag and projects for 15.42 on the bench, behind Braelon Allen (9.02); that call locks Thu 1:30 PM. Dalton Kincaid (8.02) is Questionable with a thumb, Tucker Kraft (10.77) is behind him, and that one is due today at 5:00 PM. As set, 142.95. Sorted, 152.1.

The stakes haven’t moved. AB81 is at 100% playoff odds and playing for seeding. Big Stric Energy is 2-9, at 3.5%, and playing for its season. Yesterday Big Stric was a 52.7% favorite. This morning it’s 49.9%. The gap is 0.07 points, and both teams are carrying more than that on their benches. Whoever cleans up first wins the week on paper.

quick_hits.headline: The champ claimed the second-most-added player in football
quick_hits.body: Maye I touch your TDs? dropped Buffalo Bills D/ST (5.87) for Washington Commanders D/ST (8.29), added 1,225,056 times across Sleeper. The defense slot is still empty, Washington sits on the bench, and that call is due Sun 1:25 PM. Fill it and the champ projects for 156.62 against Cherry Blossom’s 167.68. That’s 39.7%. The playoff odds say 70.8%. The claim was the easy part.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things went 2 for 2 on the wire from the last spot
quick_hits.body: Claiming eighth, Bad things man bad things got both of its claims: Antonio Williams (9.85) for Josh Downs (6.96), and New York Giants D/ST (7.94) for Los Angeles Rams D/ST (7.46). It also made every call this column asked for yesterday: Bijan Robinson in for Ollie Gordon II, Matthew Golden in for Downs, Gordon back in at flex for Jordyn Tyson. The defense slot is empty with Giants and Chicago Bears D/ST (6.07) on the bench, and it locks Thu 10:00 AM, the earliest clock in the league.

quick_hits.headline: What will the Finest do at RB by 5:00 PM?
quick_hits.body: Bhayshul Tuten (17.04) is Questionable, undisclosed. Kenneth Walker III, Out yesterday, is now Questionable with a groin and projects for 17.25. Blake Corum (11.64) is the only healthy option. The call is due today at 5:00 PM, so the Finest won’t get much more news. Chris Rodriguez Jr., Tuten’s teammate, has been added 1,533,672 times across Sleeper and nobody in R.A.T.S. claimed him. At 25.7% playoff odds, I’d grab the handcuff and start Corum only if both tags get worse.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s tight end question answered itself
quick_hits.body: Sam LaPorta no longer carries an injury designation and projects for 12.8. Poochinski skipped Tyler Higbee on the wire and its lineup as set is already its best one: 178.91 against deeboliciouskins’ 161.12, 66.3%. deeboliciouskins starts Kansas City Chiefs D/ST (5.61) with Minnesota Vikings D/ST (8.8) on its bench.

quick_hits.headline: The champ benched the most-dropped player in football
quick_hits.body: Michael Mayer is on Maye I touch your TDs?’ bench now, dropped 720,378 times across Sleeper. Harold Fannin Jr. (11.58) starts at tight end. The champ also put Breece Hall (12.27) in for Emmett Johnson and Drake London (14.47) in at flex for Omarion Hampton. Every call this column flagged yesterday, made.

quick_hits.headline: Bowers or Kelce? Cherry Blossom has till Sunday night
quick_hits.body: Brock Bowers (16.19) is Questionable with an ankle and sits behind Travis Kelce (10.32). That’s 5.87 points of upside on a bench that already projects Cherry Blossom as a 60.3% favorite. The call is due Sun 5:20 PM, the last lock on the board, so this one gets to wait for the news.

w12-m1.headline: Coin flip with homework
w12-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy 152.1, AB81 152.17 at their best; 142.95 to 133.92 as set. Big Stric’s fixes are healthy players: Barkley and Kraft. AB81’s quarterback depends on Herbert or Darnold, both Questionable.

w12-m2.headline: Cherry Blossom by 11.06 on paper
w12-m2.blurb: Cherry Blossom 167.68, Maye I touch your TDs? 156.62 with Washington in the empty defense slot. 60.3% Cherry Blossom, and Bowers is upside on top.

w12-m3.headline: LaPorta’s healthy. Poochinski’s rolling.
w12-m3.blurb: Poochinski 178.91, deeboliciouskins 161.12, 66.3% Poochinski. Poochinski’s lineup is already optimal; deeboliciouskins projects for 157.39 as set, with Minnesota Vikings D/ST (8.8) on its bench.

w12-m4.headline: 1.73 points, two Questionable backs
w12-m4.blurb: Santa Clara’s Finest 165.16, Bad things man bad things 163.43 at their best, 51.6% Finest. Bad things has to fill an empty defense slot by Thu 10:00 AM; the Finest have to pick a running back by today at 5:00 PM.

w12-r8-s0.headline: AB81 at QB: Herbert or Darnold?
w12-r8-s0.blurb: Herbert (14.62, concussion) and Darnold (15.5, quadriceps) are both Questionable. Darnold projects higher. If both sit, Stafford is alone; Deshaun Watson (16.69) is still on the wire. Due Sun 1:25 PM.

w12-r8-s5.headline: AB81 at WR: Bernard or Smith?
w12-r8-s5.blurb: Germie Bernard projects for 7.41. DeVonta Smith projects for 13.86 and Mike Evans for 13.49, both on the bench. Locks Thu 1:30 PM. Not a close call.

w12-r1-s2.headline: Big Stric at RB: Barkley’s back
w12-r1-s2.blurb: Saquon Barkley (15.42) no longer has an injury tag and sits behind Braelon Allen (9.02). That’s 6.4 points in a 0.07-point game. Locks Thu 1:30 PM.

w12-r1-s6.headline: Big Stric at TE: Kincaid or Kraft?
w12-r1-s6.blurb: Kincaid (8.02) is Questionable with a thumb; Kraft (10.77) is healthy and projects higher anyway. Due today at 5:00 PM.

w12-r7-s3.headline: The Finest at RB: Tuten, Walker or Corum?
w12-r7-s3.blurb: Tuten (17.04) and Walker (17.25) are both Questionable; Corum (11.64) is the safe floor. Due today at 5:00 PM.

w12-r5-s10.headline: Bad things at DEF: Giants or Bears?
w12-r5-s10.blurb: The new claim, New York Giants D/ST (7.94), or Chicago Bears D/ST (6.07). The slot is empty and locks Thu 10:00 AM. Start the claim.

w12-r3-s10.headline: Maye at DEF: slot in Washington
w12-r3-s10.blurb: The slot is empty and the champ just claimed Washington Commanders D/ST (8.29). Due Sun 1:25 PM.

w12-r5-s2.headline: Resolved: Robinson in for Gordon
w12-r5-s2.blurb: Bad things made the call: Bijan Robinson (18.03) starts at running back, Ollie Gordon II moves to flex.

w12-r3-s3.headline: Resolved: Breece Hall in
w12-r3-s3.blurb: Maye I touch your TDs? started Breece Hall (12.27) over Emmett Johnson (6.5).

2026-11-25-m3.blurb: Washington Commanders D/ST (8.29) for Buffalo Bills D/ST (5.87): a 2.42-point upgrade at a position the champ had empty, and the second-most-added player in Sleeper. Best move of the night. Now put it in the lineup.

2026-11-25-m2.blurb: Antonio Williams (9.85) for Josh Downs (6.96). Downs had already lost his starting job to Matthew Golden; Williams is a bench body with a better projection. Depth, not a difference-maker.

external_facts.claim: Waiver claim order for Week 12: AB81, Poochinski, deeboliciouskins, Cherry Blossom, Big Stric Energy, Maye I touch your TDs?, Santa Clara’s Finest, Bad things man bad things.
